content:
{'text': '特朗普和萬斯周一在2026年期中選舉競選活動的各自行程中，均遭到示威者叫囂。', 'paragraph_context': 'Donald Trump and JD Vance both faced hecklers during separate appearances on the 2026 midterm election campaign trail on Monday.'}

{'text': '「我他媽的恨你，我恨你」，一名女子在特朗普於堪薩斯州帕克城為參議員羅傑·馬歇爾助選時對他高喊。馬歇爾正面對與民主黨對手亞當·漢密爾頓的激烈選戰。', 'paragraph_context': '“I fucking hate you, I hate you,” one woman screamed at Trump as he stumped in Park City, Kansas, for Sen. Roger Marshall, who faces a close race against Democratic rival Adam Hamilton.'}

{'text': '這次爆發正發生在特朗普無證無據地聲稱另一名示威者是「受僱搞事者」之時。', 'paragraph_context': 'The outburst came just as Trump was claiming, without offering evidence, that another heckler was a “paid protester.”'}

{'text': '「參加特朗普的集會是多麼美好啊？」總統之後向台下觀眾說道，引發支持者高呼他的名字。', 'paragraph_context': '“How great is it to be a Trump rally?” the president asked the audience afterward, prompting supporters to chant his name.'}

{'text': '特朗普上周在俄亥俄州一場活動中對一名被毆打示威者作出幸災樂禍的回應，引發譴責。他在今次集會上亦遭到多次打斷。', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump, who last week drew condemnation over his taunting response to a protester being physically attacked at an event in Ohio, faced several other interruptions during the rally.'}

{'text': '與此同時，萬斯在北卡羅來納州亨德森維爾為共和黨候選人助選時亦被打斷。', 'paragraph_context': 'Vance, meanwhile, was interrupted while campaigning for GOP candidates in Hendersonville, North Carolina.'}

{'text': '一名示威者站在副總統正後方站起來高喊：「公開愛潑斯坦檔案」，這些檔案涉及已故性犯罪者傑弗里·愛潑斯坦的政府紀錄。愛潑斯坦曾是特朗普的親密夥伴，相關檔案至今仍未完整公開。', 'paragraph_context': 'A protester standing directly behind the vice president rose and shouted, “Release the Epstein files,” referring to government records related to the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, a one-time close associate of Trump, which have not been released in their entirety.'}

{'text': '保安將該男子帶走，群眾則發出噓聲，並開始高呼「USA、USA」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Security escorted the man away as the crowd booed and began chanting, “USA, USA.”'}

{'text': '短暫停頓後，萬斯開玩笑回應說該示威者是無證移民。', 'paragraph_context': 'After a short pause, Vance responded by joking that the protester was an undocumented immigrant.'}

{'text': '「各位女士先生們，我之前說過的話需要更正一下。我說過美國已經沒有非法入境者了」，萬斯說。', 'paragraph_context': '“Ladies and gentlemen, I’m going to have to amend something I said earlier. I said that we have had zero illegal border crossings in the United States of America,” Vance said.'}

{'text': '現場群眾報以掌聲。', 'paragraph_context': 'The crowd applauded.'}

{'text': '「但有一個也不算差，對吧？」他補充道，引得觀眾發出笑聲。', 'paragraph_context': '“But one isn’t bad, right?” he added, prompting laughter from the audience.'}
